meta.name: FOX Sports
meta.description:
On Fox Sports, you’ll find everything you need to keep up with your sports passions. Fox Sports on Pluto TV will feature a mix of game highlights, clips from FS1 studio shows and Fox Sports Digital originals.

Shows: First Things First, The Herd With Colin Cowherd, MLB Epic Moments, Fox Sports Podcasts, First Things First: OT
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, The Roku Channel, Plex
